home.dhbvnSubheading: Strengthening Southern Haryana’s Power Infrastructure with Quality HDPE Pipes
home.dhbvnParagraph1: Solanki Industries (Solanki Pipes) is proud to announce its empanelment with Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited (DHBVN) under the category of HDPE Pipes. This achievement reflects our commitment to manufacturing high-quality, ISI-marked HDPE piping solutions with a 50-year design life that meet the stringent requirements of government infrastructure and utility projects across southern Haryana.
home.dhbvnParagraph2: The empanelment enables Solanki Industries to participate in DHBVN-related turnkey and deposit works, supporting the development of reliable underground electrical infrastructure across southern Haryana.

dhbvnAccordions.title: What is DHBVN?
dhbvnAccordions.content: DHBVN is a state-owned electricity distribution utility engaged in power distribution, electrification, underground cabling, and power infrastructure development projects across southern Haryana.

dhbvnAccordions.title: Why HDPE Pipes are Essential for Electrical Infrastructure
dhbvnAccordions.content: HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene) pipes have become the preferred choice for underground cable protection due to their exceptional properties: high mechanical strength to withstand external soil loads, corrosion resistance, internal smoothness for cable protection, and long service life exceeding 50 years.

dhbvnAccordions.title: Solanki Industries: Trusted HDPE Pipe Manufacturer
dhbvnAccordions.content: Serving since 2008, Solanki Industries has established itself as a trusted and premium brand name in the HDPE pipe segment with ISI marked pipes (IS 4984 and IS 14333), BIS licensed manufacturing facility, advanced automated production lines, and in-house quality testing laboratory.

dhbvnAccordions.title: Supporting Growth, Quality & Compliance
dhbvnAccordions.content: The DHBVN empanelment reinforces Solanki Industries’ growing contribution to government infrastructure development, supporting DHBVN contractors, turnkey agencies, EPC companies, and government departments with quality-driven products.

about.introParagraph1: Established in 2008, Solanki Industries (Brand: Solanki Pipes) has grown into a trusted name in the piping industry across India. As a BIS-Licensed manufacturer with licences IS 4984:2016 (CM/L 9100182616) and IS 14333:2022 (CM/L 9100198114), we specialize in HDPE pipes for water supply, sewerage, agriculture, and infrastructure applications, in sizes 20 mm to 1000 mm OD across PE 80 and PE 100 grades.
about.introParagraph2: With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities located at Fatehabad Road, Mehuwala, Fatehabad (Haryana), and storage and dispatch yard at Sarsa Ghoghra, Bhiwani (Haryana), we are a dynamic, quality-focused organization committed to excellence.

farmersFair.subtitle: Empowering the agricultural heartland of Haryana through advanced irrigation solutions, modern infrastructure education, and direct farmer support.
farmersFair.mainImageCaption: Honourable Vice Chairman of Haryana addressing the gathering at the Solanki Pipes Pavilion

factsheet.keyFocus: Sustainable Irrigation, Water Conservation & Farmer Education

sections.title: Event Overview
sections.p1: The primary objective of the Farmers’ Fair and Agricultural Exhibition was to introduce the rural farming communities of Haryana to state-of-the-art agricultural technologies, advanced irrigation solutions, and improved crop-management practices. Designed to bridge the gap between innovation and traditional farming, the exhibition acted as a robust educational platform for direct interaction, training, and knowledge-sharing.
sections.p2: Farmers were introduced to automated sprinklers, high-durability HDPE pipes, water flow controllers, and soil preservation tools designed to boost overall crop yields while significantly conserving vital natural resources like water and power.

sections.title: Distinguished Presence & State Recognition
sections.p1: The event witnessed notable participation from prominent agricultural scientists, university researchers, and government dignitaries, including the Honourable Vice Chairman of Haryana.
sections.p2: During his keynote speech, the Vice Chairman commended Solanki Pipes for their dedication to rural empowerment, sustainable water management, and the manufacturing of high-grade, BIS-certified piping solutions.

sections.title: Technical Demonstrations & Farmer Empowerment
sections.p1: At our dedicated exhibition pavilion, Solanki Pipes engineers and agricultural consultants hosted live demonstrations showing the impact of modern micro-irrigation systems vs. traditional flood irrigation.
sections.p2: Farmers gained hands-on experience evaluating flexible sprinkler layouts, quick-coupling systems, and wear-resistant HDPE pipelines designed to withstand harsh northern weather conditions.

sections.title: Community Impact & Future Initiatives
sections.p1: More than 2,500 farmers, agricultural students, and local cooperative leaders visited the Solanki Pipes installation during the fair.
sections.p2: Solanki Pipes distributed educational handbooks on water conservation, soil nutrition preservation, and modern piping maintenance to hundreds of farming families, continuing our social pledge to build a greener, more resilient tomorrow.
